rules.statement: A court should not enforce a sale against a purchaser misled by its duly accredited agents, especially when the sale was under the direction of the court and created through misrepresentations or misleading conduct.
rules.supporting_quote: "It would be disastrous, it would be shocking, if the Court were to enforce against a purchaser misled by its duly accredited agents a bargain so illusory and so unconscientious as this."
